title: CommunityPasteDeletedPayload
description: community.paste.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Community server/events.js, queued in the transaction of the change). A paste was deleted (its content and image link are gone; the slug stays reserved). Consumers that indexed or cached it drop it. Envelope: subject { type: paste, id }, visibility public when the item is public else internal, priority low, actor the person or service:community.
